dataset： GSE163151

## **1.Dataset preparations**

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(factoextra)
library(ggrepel)
library(GGally)
```
1.2.Grab data

```{r}
gse <- getGEO("GSE163151")

```
1.3 Grab metadata

```{r}

metadata <- pData(gse$GSE163151_series_matrix.txt.gz)

```

1.4
```{r}

metadata <- metadata |>  
  select(
    "title"
  ) |>
  separate(
    title,
    into = c("condition", "sample_id"),
    sep = "_",
    extra = "merge"
  )
metadata$count_id <- sub(
  "_S[0-9]+_L00([0-9]+)$",
  "_\\1",
  metadata$sample_id
)
head(metadata)


```

1.5
```{r}
list.files("GSE163151/samples", full.names = TRUE)

counts_list <- list.files("GSE163151/samples", pattern = "*.txt.gz", full.names = T) %>%
  set_names(., basename(.) %>% str_remove("_counts.txt.gz")) %>%
  map(read.delim, header=T, row.names=1)

counts <- do.call(cbind, counts_list)

dim(counts)

```
1.6
```{r}
metadata$count_id ==colnames(counts)


```
